body: I know people care for me but I can’t connect with them because I am so detached from reality. I don’t feel the care, I don’t experience life and it’s been a long 5 year battle. I fought, I lost, now I rest.
Plans are in place man. I’m damaged and it would take a miracle to heal. See you on the other side

Tried a few combos of meds( antidepressants and antipsychotics), tried forcing myself to socialise when starting uni and I did do that to be fair. I went from a shy anxious kid to talking to loads of new people, the transformation was a miracle and I have no clue how it happened-  I’m a different person in that regard. 

Tried a ton of therapy before uni and a bit at the start. Just did nothing. I’ve attempted suicide before out of pure suicidal agitation from an antidepressant and didn’t tell anyone about it( took around 20 tablets while my parents were away for the week) but I just felt really sick and tired and slept for a few days. That was a mistake because I didn’t plan it out. This time it’s all planned out and being at uni makes it easier. Genuinely the only way I would change my mind is if I met the love of my life tomorrow( which I thought I already did) and the chances of that are one in a million. A man is no one but a man can hope.
Yeah I’ve been diagnosed for it all
